result.instructions: Tools for DocRaptor, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "List my 20 latest documents with their names and creation dates."; "List the last 10 documents I generated and when each was made."; "Which IP addresses should I allowlist so documents can load my images?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes DocRaptor data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run docraptor_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run docraptor_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run docraptor_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. docraptor_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: docraptor_create_document
tools.title: Create a document (PDF/XLS/XLSX)
tools.description: Generate a PDF or Excel document from HTML (document_content) or a URL (document_url). Exactly one of document_content / document_url is required. By default the document is HOSTED and the tool returns a { download_url } you can fetch — ideal for agents (no large binary in the response). Hosted documents require a paid DocRaptor add-on. Without that add-on, set hosted:false to get the raw document back as base64, or async:true to enqueue a job and poll docraptor_get_document_status. Test mode is enabled by default: PDFs are watermarked and Excel files are limited to 20 rows. Set test:false explicitly to create a real document that consumes account credits (billed). DocRaptor API: POST /docs.

document_content.description: The HTML/XML source to render. Use this OR document_url.

document_url.description: A URL DocRaptor will fetch and render. Use this OR document_content.

type.description: Output format: pdf (default), xls, or xlsx.

name.description: A name for the document (<=200 chars), shown in the DocRaptor dashboard/listing.

test.description: Default true: generate a FREE test document (watermarked PDF or Excel limited to 20 rows). Set false explicitly for a real, BILLED document.

hosted.description: Default true for synchronous requests, false for async. Requires the paid hosted-documents add-on; each download may be billed. Set false for raw base64 output without the add-on.

async.description: If true, enqueue the job and return a status_id (poll with docraptor_get_document_status). Best for large/slow documents. Default false.

hosted_download_limit.description: For hosted docs: max number of downloads before the link expires.

hosted_expires_at.description: For hosted docs: ISO 8601 datetime when the hosted link expires.

pipeline.description: Rendering pipeline/engine version, e.g. '10'. Omit to use DocRaptor's default.

tag.description: An arbitrary tag string for your own reporting/grouping.

javascript.description: Enable DocRaptor's JavaScript engine (default false), recommended for Typekit and Highcharts. Separate from prince_options.javascript; usually enable only one engine.

strict.description: PDF HTML validation: html fails on invalid HTML; none disables strict HTML validation.

help.description: Enable DocRaptor help mode: emails you and DocRaptor support and retains document contents for review until resolved. Maximum five active help requests.

referrer.description: Explicit referrer for JavaScript requests, e.g. Typekit with document_content. Defaults to document_url.

callback_url.description: URL DocRaptor POSTs after a successful async job (requires async:true). Failed jobs do not trigger callbacks.

ignore_resource_errors.description: Ignore errors downloading CSS/images (DocRaptor default true). Set false to fail generation on resource errors.

ignore_console_messages.description: Ignore JavaScript console messages instead of failing generation. Defaults to false on Pipelines 1–6, true on Pipeline 7+.

javascript.description: Enable Prince's JavaScript engine (default false), separate from top-level javascript. Usually enable only one engine to avoid running scripts twice.

baseurl.description: Base URL for resolving relative asset paths in document_content.

pdf_title.description: Title metadata embedded in the PDF.

max_passes.description: Max Prince layout passes (for JS-driven layouts).

version.description: Deprecated Prince version selector. Prefer the top-level pipeline parameter.

no_network.description: Disable network access and HTTP downloads.

no_parallel_downloads.description: Fetch assets sequentially, useful for hosts with strict rate limits.

http_user.description: Username for HTTP authentication when fetching resources.

http_password.description: Password for HTTP authentication when fetching resources.

http_proxy.description: HTTP proxy server used to fetch resources.

http_timeout.description: External resource request timeout in seconds (1–60; DocRaptor default 10).

insecure.description: Disable SSL verification for resource downloads (not recommended).

no_embed_fonts.description: Disable font embedding in PDF output.

no_subset_fonts.description: Disable font subsetting in PDF output.

key_bits.description: PDF encryption key size: 40 or 128 bits.

user_password.description: PDF user password, required to open the encrypted document.

owner_password.description: PDF owner password for controlling document permissions.

allow_copy_for_accessibility.description: Allow accessibility copying even when disallow_copy is true (Pipeline 9+).

allow_assembly.description: Allow document assembly even when disallow_modify is true (Pipeline 9+).

css_dpi.description: CSS pixel resolution in dots per inch (DocRaptor default 96).

profile.description: PDF conformance profile (PDF/A, PDF/UA, or PDF/X). Supported profiles depend on the pipeline.

tools.name: docraptor_get_document_status
tools.title: Get async document status
tools.description: Check the status of an asynchronous document created with docraptor_create_document({async:true}). Returns status (queued | working | completed | failed), and when completed a download_url / download_id / number_of_pages. DocRaptor API: GET /status/{status_id}.

status_id.description: The status_id returned by docraptor_create_document when async:true.

tools.name: docraptor_list_documents
tools.title: List documents
tools.description: List metadata for documents created on this account, most recent first (paginated). Note: DocRaptor does not retain the rendered files themselves — this returns metadata such as name, type, test flag, and creation time. DocRaptor API: GET /docs.json.

tools.name: docraptor_list_ip_addresses
tools.title: List DocRaptor IP addresses
tools.description: List the IP addresses DocRaptor uses to fetch remote assets / document_url. Useful for allowlisting DocRaptor on a firewall or asset host. (DocRaptor notes these change over time — prefer HTTP Basic auth over IP allowlisting for securing assets.) DocRaptor API: GET /ips.json.
